# AP Policy Notes - Ops Copy

## Three Way Match

For inventory purchases, AP should match the invoice, purchase order, and
receiving note before releasing payment.

If the invoice bills more units than were received, AP may pay only for units
received when the purchase order allows partial shipments. The unmatched units
stay on hold until receiving confirms delivery or Procurement cancels the
remaining quantity.

## Bank Change Control

Any vendor bank-account change requires a callback to a previously verified
contact and a second approver in AP. Payment should remain on hold if the
callback is not completed.

## Approval Threshold

Invoices above $10,000 require manager approval unless the purchase order was
pre-approved for the same or higher amount.
